subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Rasha stepped __backward__ to avoid the incoming traffic.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Forward**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"backward"** means moving or directed toward the back or rear, or in reverse direction. (पीछे की ओर)

 
 
• **Example:** Rasha stepped backward to avoid the incoming traffic.
 
 
 
• **"Forward"** refers to moving or directed toward the front or in the direction of progress; it is the antonym of backward. (आगे की ओर)
 
 
• **Example:** He leaned forward to get a better view of the stage.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'backward'** is **'forward'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Forward**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Afront** (सामने): Positioned in front or ahead; not commonly used in modern English.

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers marched afront of their leader.
 
 
 
• **Beside** (बगल में): Next to or alongside something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She sat beside me during the concert.
 
 
 
• **Behind** (पीछे): At the back or rear of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The car was parked behind the building.
